verdict.reasons: The candidate clearly shows the expected white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll with readable and authentic branding. The scene context matches the agromony article focus with neutral seedlings, soil, and continuous drip lines showing localized wetting. There are no core defects such as mixed products, fake logos, impossible geometry, people, or collage. The small clearance between the carton and the irrigation line is appropriate. The required watermark is present. Minor framing or depth-of-field variations are advisory only and do not affect the pass status.

focused_physical_review.reason: A broad uninterrupted gap of soil is visible around the entire footprint of the AFP package, including behind it; the nearest black irrigation line is separated by this clear gap and does not touch, emerge from, or cross the package. There are no distinct additional loose coils, and no white ribbons, straps, or tape tails protruding from the sides or base of the carton.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
